meta.antd: Ant Design 6; component palettes computed by its light/dark algorithms. Application seed overrides come from generated colors.ts.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the header, status bar and the three workspace panels.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Header, workspace panels and cue cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, panel and select (13:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, cue metadata, field labels, the subtitle and media path on panel, bg and select. Light holds 4.5:1 on bg and select with almost no margin; do not put it on anything darker.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: panel and card borders, the header rule, the cue-editor divider, the dashed media placeholder. Decorative only (1.2:1 and 1.4:1); never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Fill of a hovered or selected cue card.

tokens.name: cue-accent
tokens.usage: Border of a hovered or selected cue card and the 3px inset bar of the playing cue. Hard-coded in the source, so it does not shift in dark (3.0:1 on dark panel).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ant Design colorPrimary: primary button fill, focused input border, checked switch and checkbox. White text on it: 5.5:1 light, 6.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill; default button hover border and text (antd colorPrimaryHover).

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill (antd colorPrimaryActive).

tokens.name: primary-bg
tokens.usage: Selected option fill in Select dropdowns (antd controlItemBgActive).

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on primary and speaker fills (antd colorTextLightSolid). Nothing in the app is filled with danger.

tokens.name: control-bg
tokens.usage: Input, select and default button fill (antd colorBgContainer). Dark is antd's own #141414, a shade darker than panel.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input, select and default button border (antd colorBorder).

tokens.name: control-text
tokens.usage: Text inside antd controls, tags and alerts (antd colorText).

tokens.name: control-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button and input text, placeholders (antd colorTextDisabled). Intentionally below contrast minimums, as in antd.

tokens.name: control-bg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button and input fill (antd colorBgContainerDisabled).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal, dropdown and message fill (antd colorBgElevated).

tokens.name: mask
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals (antd colorBgMask).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger button (取消处理) border and text, error messages, on panel and bg: 5.6:1 light, 4.9:1 dark. Raised from antd's default #ff4d4f / #dc4446 (3.3:1); the Provider sets colorError #cf1322 in light and seeds #ff7875 in dark. The app still ships the antd default.

tokens.name: video-ground
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind the video element in both themes.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Highlight behind characters the suggestion removes, with line-through. ink on it: 11.8:1 light, 11.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Highlight behind characters the suggestion adds, set at weight 600. ink on it: 12.3:1 light, 9.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: speaker-1
tokens.usage: First speaker tag fill, on-solid text. 4.1:1: below 4.5:1 at 12px, kept from the source.

tokens.name: speaker-2
tokens.usage: Second speaker tag fill, on-solid text. 2.3:1: fails for text, kept from the source; pair with the speaker name, never color alone.

tokens.name: speaker-3
tokens.usage: Third speaker tag fill, on-solid text. 3.6:1: below 4.5:1, kept from the source.

tokens.name: speaker-4
tokens.usage: Fourth speaker fill. Only the Go analysis palette (internal/analysis) has it; speakers added by hand in the UI cycle through speaker-1 to speaker-3. on-solid text: 6.9:1.

tokens.name: tag-default-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral tag fill: Unknown speaker, OpenAI 未配置 (antd colorFillQuaternary).

tokens.name: tag-green-text
tokens.usage: Ready status tag text (FFmpeg 已就绪, OpenAI 已配置) on tag-green-bg and bg: 5.4:1 light, 7.0:1 dark. Light raised from antd green-7 #389e0d (3.4:1) to green-8; the app still ships green-7.

tokens.name: tag-green-bg
tokens.usage: Ready status tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-green-border
tokens.usage: Ready status tag border.

tokens.name: tag-orange-text
tokens.usage: Attention tag text (待复核, 需人工复核, FFmpeg 未安装) on tag-orange-bg and bg: 5.1:1 light, 7.1:1 dark. Light raised from antd orange-7 #d46b08 (3.3:1) to orange-8; the app still ships orange-7.

tokens.name: tag-orange-bg
tokens.usage: Attention tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-orange-border
tokens.usage: Attention tag border.

tokens.name: tag-gold-text
tokens.usage: Unapplied-edit tag text (尚未套用) on tag-gold-bg and bg: 5.2:1 light, 8.2:1 dark. Light raised from antd gold-7 #d48806 (2.8:1); the app still ships gold-7.

tokens.name: tag-gold-bg
tokens.usage: Unapplied-edit tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-gold-border
tokens.usage: Unapplied-edit tag border.

tokens.name: tag-blue-text
tokens.usage: Pending suggestion tag text (待确认, 已接受, 已拒绝). 5.5:1 light, 4.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: tag-blue-bg
tokens.usage: Pending suggestion tag fill; also the info Alert fill (antd colorInfoBg).

tokens.name: tag-blue-border
tokens.usage: Pending suggestion tag border; also the info Alert border (antd colorInfoBorder).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning Alert fill (yt-dlp missing).

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Warning Alert border.

tokens.name: head
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: wave
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: wave-sel
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Application semantic color.

tokens.name: error-seed
tokens.usage: Ant Design algorithm input (not the computed danger color).

families.antd: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The product name in the header, once per window. Source line height is normal.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: h2 at the top of each workspace panel and its sub-sections (校正建议). Source line height is normal.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: h3 for the cue editor and the YouTube result title.

styles.name: cue-text
styles.sample: 我們今天要討論新的字幕編集器。
styles.usage: Subtitle text in a cue card, pre-wrap so line breaks from the SRT survive.

styles.name: comparison
styles.sample: 可以先保留原本的字幕，再讓使用者確認修正。
styles.usage: Original and proposed text in a suggestion card.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: 每次 1–5 分钟。请自行确认选取范围与音频内容。
styles.usage: Muted helper text (.muted), counts beside a panel title, the media path.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: 字幕校正 · 说话人辨识
styles.usage: The line under the brand name and the theme toggle label.

styles.name: micro-label
styles.usage: Column labels in the suggestion comparison.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The playhead readout under the video, always HH:MM:SS,mmm.

styles.name: cue-meta
styles.usage: Cue identifier and time range at the top of a cue card.

styles.name: time-field
styles.usage: Start and end inputs in the cue editor.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, alerts (antd fontSize 14, lineHeight 1.5714).

styles.name: control-sm
styles.usage: Tags and small buttons (antd fontSizeSM 12, lineHeightSM 1.6667).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the brand name and the subtitle line.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a time-field label and its input.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between the theme toggle label and switch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between cue cards; gaps in section headings, speaker lists, the speaker form and range labels.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space above and below the text in a cue card.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Status bar vertical padding; gap between cue-editor rows and time fields.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cue and suggestion cards; space below a section heading; comparison column gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between the three workspace panels; space above the cue editor.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space below a panel title; range field gap; space above notices.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Panel padding; workspace side and bottom gutter; header bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Status bar side padding; header gap; space around the clock.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Header top and left padding; space above range fields; hr margin.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Space between the speaker form and the suggestions heading.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Workspace panels.

tokens.name: radius-suggestion
tokens.usage: Suggestion cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cue cards, video, media placeholder, buttons and inputs (antd borderRadius); also the corner of the 32px app mark.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Alerts and modals (antd borderRadiusLG).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small buttons (antd borderRadiusSM).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs (antd controlHeight).

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in the status bar and speaker list (antd controlHeightSM).

tokens.name: statusbar-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the status bar.

tokens.name: video-max-height
tokens.usage: Tallest the video element grows.

tokens.name: placeholder-height
tokens.usage: Height of the empty media placeholder.

tokens.name: col-media-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the media column (0.95fr).

tokens.name: col-cues-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the cue column (1.25fr).

tokens.name: col-review-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the review column (1fr).

tokens.name: workspace-min-height
tokens.usage: Workspace never shrinks below this; otherwise it fills 100vh minus 150px.

tokens.name: bp-two-column
tokens.usage: At or below: two columns, review panel spans both, header stacks.

tokens.name: bp-one-column
tokens.usage: At or below: panels stack in one column.

tokens.name: opacity-settled
tokens.usage: Accepted or rejected suggestion cards.

tokens.name: shadow-playing
tokens.usage: Marks the cue under the playhead; combines with the selected state.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals and dropdowns (antd boxShadow). Panels and cards never take a shadow.
